title: Remote Privacy and Digital Safety
headline: Improve privacy settings on enrolled devices without making them difficult to use.
description: Remote help with browser, device, messaging, DNS, and VPN privacy settings for Central Florida Remote Support Plan clients.
metaTitle: Remote Privacy Help for Central Florida Plan Clients
metaDescription: Improve browser, device, messaging, DNS, and VPN privacy settings through a guided remote session for enrolled Central Florida clients.

sections.heading: Did You Know?
paragraph: Many applications and devices begin with data collection and personalized advertising enabled.
Browser and device settings can reduce unnecessary tracking without blocking normal daily use.
A VPN changes who can see parts of your internet traffic, but it does not make every activity anonymous or safe.

sections.heading: What We Help With
items: Review browser privacy settings and extensions
Reduce unnecessary device telemetry, advertising identifiers, and location access
Review privacy settings for messaging and email applications
Evaluate VPN settings and explain what they do and do not protect
Remove unnecessary applications, permissions, and background services

sections.heading: What to Expect
paragraph: This service requires an active Remote Support Plan and an enrolled device.
We begin with your privacy goals, review the relevant settings, and explain the available tradeoffs.
We make only the changes you approve and show you how to manage them afterward.

faq.question: Do I need the Remote Support Plan for privacy help?
faq.answer: Yes. Remote Privacy and Digital Safety is available only for devices enrolled in an active Remote Support Plan.

faq.question: What privacy settings can you help with?
faq.answer: The session can cover browsers, device telemetry, advertising identifiers, messaging, email, DNS filtering, VPN settings, application permissions, and location access.

faq.question: Will you explain each change?
faq.answer: Yes. We explain what a setting changes, its limitations, and any effect it may have on normal device use.
